unresolved.text: The appendix enumerates every entry recovered from the pinned HUMANS corpus, but dynamic/nested handoffs and numeric predicates remain unresolved. Join those entries and the separately listed phone topics to exact original eligibility and deduplicate semantic overlaps; do not treat an entry count as a unique-event census.

Inspection, shop and door responses now have exact subtitle IDs. Some object identities, per-object owners and state gates remain unjoined; shared response lines alone do not establish every drawer or door's behavior.
Every unassigned native AUTH resource/owner needs classification as a listed event, variant, ambient staging, duplicate or non-gameplay content. 491 logical AUTH records are not 491 events.

QTE misses, fight losses and repeat-workday outcomes now have encounter-specific review cases; guard/help stages, missed appointments and phone topics have original subtitle evidence. Still map unique original outcome films and their actual restart/progression rules. Current adaptation retries are not original evidence.
Verify optional scene dates, weather, earlier choices and expiry against original data or captured playthroughs. Guide disagreements, especially Nozomi's park prerequisites, remain unresolved.

Current move catalog puts Twin Blades in Fuku-san's room and Shadow Reaper in the passage. Shotgunnova lists the reverse. Both location fields below are explicitly disputed; do not copy the implementation as original truth.

Current Stab Armor adaptation uses Master Chen. Original E1060A015 says to ask Gui Zhang and E1060A016 attributes the explanation to him; this independently supports the annotated original subtitle-container list. Join SA1108/SA1109's exact lesson and poem owners before correcting gameplay.

DRAUTH, DJHN, D0W0, JHW0, KAKG and dream resources contain multiple selectable activities. Some are phases of listed events, others may be additional events. Preserve unresolved mappings instead of inventing meanings from filenames.

Shenmue II, trailers, Passport tutorials, debug-only scenes, unused content, achievements, pause/settings menus and post-clear bonus modes are outside this Shenmue I playthrough inventory. Record a disputed in-game event here before excluding it.
